LESSON: WRITING 10.4.1 CREATIVE WRITING- DESCRIPTIVE COMPOSITIONS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade six
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.4: Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing- Descriptive Compositions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing- Descriptive Compositions, part of Strand 10 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade six ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why should you plan your compositio n? 2) How do we describe objects, people or events?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

A. select sounds, words and phrases from a text for listening fluency,
